assignment: Write a release-owner memo on an application bug and the smallest credible repair validation.
source: A receipt service writes a receipt and then acknowledges a job. A retry patch went live at 09:00. Of 1,000 jobs, 18 timed out after a successful write. Logs show 17 duplicate receipts share a job ID and one has no matching trace. The worker fleet can roll back in ten minutes. Existing tests cover first-time delivery only.

criteria.full: Explains the write-before-ack retry window and uses the 17 matching IDs as evidence with one unresolved case.
criteria.partial: Names retries but doesn't connect write, acknowledgment and duplicate creation.

criteria.full: Proposes idempotency keyed by stable job ID with an atomic persistent decision that survives parallel retries.
criteria.partial: Suggests an in-memory flag or a duplicate check with a race window.

criteria.full: Tests the specific crash window, concurrent redelivery and normal delivery with one logical receipt per job.
criteria.partial: Adds a generic retry test without a crash or concurrency assertion.

criteria.full: Sets a rollback or containment action, monitors duplicates per job, and assigns follow-up for the unmatched receipt.
criteria.partial: Lists monitoring without a concrete action or follow-up.
